---
title: "08 - SPARK-X and nnSVG"
subtitle: "Genes whose expression follows space"
---

```{r}
source("_helpers.R")
source("_figures.R")
sx_f <- find_tab("^sparkx_svgs\\.csv$")
nv_f <- find_tab("^nnsvg_spatially_variable_genes\\.csv$")
sx <- read_files(sx_f)
nv <- read_files(nv_f)
```

SPARK-X tests every gene in each sample for a spatial pattern. nnSVG then measures, on the SPARK-X hits, how much of each gene's variance is spatial.

```{r}
page_top(
  stages = "cci",
  Input = "The spatial object's counts and positions, per sample.",
  Method = "SPARK-X with hits at FDR below <code>sparkx_fdr</code>, then nnSVG on them with the <code>nnsvg_order</code> cell order when <code>run_nnsvg</code> is on.",
  Output = "The tables in <code>tables/08_cci/sparkx</code> and <code>tables/08_cci/nnsvg</code>."
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(render_tree(list(
  "SPARK-X" = function() {
    if (is.null(sx) || !all(c("sample", "significant") %in% names(sx))) return(missing_note("SPARK-X has not run."))
    fig <- rfig("sparkx_counts", sx_f, function() {
      d <- sx[, .(hits = sum(significant %in% TRUE), tested = .N), by = sample][, sample := factor(sample, rev(sample_levels(sample)))]
      ggplot(d, aes(hits, sample)) +
        geom_col(fill = TEAL, width = 0.7) +
        geom_text(aes(label = paste0(fmt_n(hits), " of ", fmt_n(tested))), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.8, colour = "grey30") +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.3))) +
        labs(x = "Spatially variable genes", y = NULL) +
        theme_report()
    }, 7, 1.2 + 0.3 * length(unique(sx$sample)))
    tagList(
      rgallery(list(`Spatially variable genes per sample` = fig), wide = TRUE),
      hits_table(sx, csv = sx_f, order = "adjustedPval")
    )
  },
  "nnSVG" = function() {
    if (is.null(nv) || !all(c("sample", "gene", "prop_sv") %in% names(nv))) return(missing_note("nnSVG has not run."))
    fig <- rfig("nnsvg_top", nv_f, function() {
      d <- nv[order(-prop_sv)][, head(.SD, 12), by = sample]
      d[, gene := reorder(paste(gene, sample, sep = "___"), prop_sv)]
      ggplot(d, aes(prop_sv, gene)) +
        geom_col(fill = TEAL, width = 0.7) +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
        scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02))) +
        facet_wrap(~sample, scales = "free_y") +
        labs(x = "Share of the gene's variance that is spatial", y = NULL) +
        theme_report()
    }, 10, 1.6 + 2.6 * ceiling(length(unique(nv$sample)) / 3))
    tagList(
      rgallery(list(`The 12 genes with the most spatial variance in each sample` = fig), big = TRUE),
      hits_table(nv, csv = nv_f, order = "padj", note = "prop_sv is the share of a gene's variance that is spatial.")
    )
  },
  ".pipeline" = function() pipeline_figures(c(figs("08_cci/sparkx", "\\.png$", FALSE), figs("08_cci/nnsvg", "\\.png$", FALSE))),
  "Parameters" = function() params_table(c("sparkx_fdr", "run_nnsvg", "nnsvg_use_sparkx", "nnsvg_max_genes", "nnsvg_order"), "cci")
)))
```
